description: This file defines functions and constants for quoting and dequoting strings, particularly for shell safety, path handling, and string literal creation in other languages. It provides utilities for quoting, dequoting, and formatting strings to ensure safe command-line and script execution.

methods.name: sq_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string and appends it to a strbuf buffer, handling shell safety by escaping special characters.

methods.name: sq_quote_argv
methods.description: Quotes an array of strings as shell-safe arguments and appends to a strbuf.

methods.name: sq_quotef
methods.description: Formats and quotes a string with printf-style formatting, appending the result to a strbuf.

methods.name: sq_quote_buf_pretty
methods.description: Quotes a string for human-readable output, avoiding quotes if not necessary.

methods.name: sq_quote_argv_pretty
methods.description: Prettily quotes an array of strings for human-readable output.

methods.name: sq_append_quote_argv_pretty
methods.description: Appends human-readable quoted arguments to a strbuf.

methods.name: sq_dequote
methods.description: Removes quoting from a string produced by sq_quote, if applicable.

methods.name: sq_dequote_step
methods.description: Dequotes a string and provides the next position for repeated calls.

methods.name: sq_dequote_to_argv
methods.description: Dequotes a string into an argv array, modifying in place.

methods.name: sq_dequote_to_strvec
methods.description: Dequotes a string into a strvec, duplicating and owning the strings.

methods.name: unquote_c_style
methods.description: Dequotes a C-style quoted string.

methods.name: quote_c_style
methods.description: Quotes a string in C style with optional flags for quoting behavior.

methods.name: quote_two_c_style
methods.description: Quotes two strings in C style, used for pairing names and values.

methods.name: write_name_quoted
methods.description: Writes a name quoted suitably for shell or other use, ending with a terminator.

methods.name: write_name_quoted_relative
methods.description: Writes a relative path name quoted for shell or script use.

methods.name: quote_path
methods.description: Quotes a path as relative to a prefix, with options for quoting style.

methods.name: perl_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for Perl string literals.

methods.name: perl_quote_buf_with_len
methods.description: Quotes a string with a specified length for Perl.

methods.name: python_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for safe use as a Python string literal.

methods.name: tcl_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for safe use in Tcl scripts.

methods.name: basic_regex_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for use as a basic regex pattern.
